newsitem.title: CHINA: China to add 111 more trains for holiday trekkers.
newsitem.headline: China to add 111 more trains for holiday trekkers.

text.p: China will add 111 extra trains to its national network to help handle an expected flood of travellers returning home for the traditional Chinese New Year festival in early February, a railway official said on Friday.

Authorities had ordered the extra trains to help carry the 133 million passengers expected to ride the nation's railroads during the holiday season from January 18 to March 8, an official with the Ministry of Railways said by telephone.
The ministry would this year end the use of tent-covered carriages used in the past to move people cattle-style on the overloaded transportation system, the official said.
Most of the holiday traffic would be concentrated in thriving eastern coastal areas, in southwestern Sichuan province and in southern Guangdong province, he said.
Many holiday travellers are migrant workers who have moved from rural areas to more affluent cities in search of work.

Beijing has said it will add more than 4,000 train carriages, 35,000 buses and 180 boats to existing services to cater for those of China's 1.2 billion people who plan to make the trek home for the Spring Festival, or Chinese New Year.
This year's festival falls on February 7.
